input.summary: Convert the mutual no-hire covering all employees into a 12-month non-solicitation limited to personnel directly involved in the services, with general-advertising and unsolicited-approach carve-outs.
input.comment: [Playbook] We cannot accept a no-hire covering all employees, so we have narrowed this to a mutual non-solicitation of personnel directly involved in the services for twelve months after their involvement ends, with the customary carve-outs for general advertising and unsolicited approaches. This reflects our playbook fallback position on restrictive covenants.

ops.oldText: During the term of this Agreement and for a period of one year thereafter, both parties agree not to hire or allow its respective affiliates to hire any employee of the other party, or any person who was an employee of the other party during the previous six months and who was directly involved in the provision of services under this Agreement.
ops.newText: During the term of this Agreement and for a period of twelve (12) months after the end of the relevant individual's involvement in the provision of services under this Agreement, neither party shall directly solicit for employment any employee of the other party who was directly involved in the provision of services under this Agreement. This Section does not restrict either party from hiring any person, and does not apply to general advertisements or other recruitment efforts not specifically targeted at the other party's personnel, or to any person who approaches a party on an unsolicited basis or in response to such general advertisement.
